records.text: Owens said a Semafor chart showed that The Daily Wire's revenue growth slowed, it had no subscriber growth in the prior year, and its advertising declined.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And Semafor actually produced a chart showing the decline of a daily wire. It's remarkable. The revenue growth has slowed. ... They've admitted that they had no subscriber growth this past year. Their advertising, go back to the advertising on the right hand side, seeing how that has dropped.

verification.notes: Semafor reports that paid subscriptions dropped by a third in 2025 and that advertising revenue fell each year since 2022, supporting the cited direction of subscriber and advertising weakness. The article describes an actual subscription decline rather than merely no growth, and the exact claim about a chart and slowed revenue growth is not fully reproduced in the text reviewed. The citation is substantially but not exactly supported.
